title: Should Jets target QB Brendan Sorsby in the NFL Supplemental Draft?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Should Jets target QB Brendan Sorsby in the NFL Supplemental Draft?
sources.description: With the Jets perpetually seeking a long-term solution at the quarterback position, it’s only natural that they would be considered one of the likely candidates to try to land QB Brendan Sorsby in the Supplemental Draft.
